$comment: Every tool the box runs, pinned by version and SHA-256. A change here is a reviewed PR.

softnet.$comment: Upstream Softnet as its authors ship it, never patched or built on the box. It logs no packet it drops, so a job's record says refusals by Softnet itself are not reported; taskbox's own rules evaluator (src/net/rules.ts) says what they block, and the selftest checks that the two agree.

tailscale.$comment: tailscale and tailscaled v1.104.5, built twice by build-tailscale.yml, the two builds identical, and attached to the published release tailscale-v1.104.5-2 of the box's release repo (org, repo and releaseRepo in taskbox.json) as this asset. The install reads the asset with the App's token, then checks the tarball and each binary against these. url is the same asset, kept only for installs from before asset, which run the next update.
